thread:
alex: Heads-up — we need to hold the runtime unpin for the cutover tonight (hotfix-v3.2.1). QA found a long-tail kv-cache regression on longseq. Can we discuss rollback criteria and safehold plan?

maya: ack. can you paste the failing repro or metrics?

alex: pasted stack from QA run below. failing on >8k tokens when kvcache misses spike.
```
err: kvcache-oob at kernel.c:421
trace: runtime->kernel_select -> quant_path -> kv_read
qps: baseline 120 -> repro 95 (tail latency +300ms p99)
```

sam: interesting — this only crops up on runtime 4.14.2 with sdk 2.9.0? or also earlier?

jordan: we ran comparative canary: runtime 4.14.1 + sdk 2.8.7 = no repro. 4.14.2 + 2.9.0 repros consistently in longseq perf harness.

lee: Deploy-bot shows the change landed at 1818920000 and was unpinned in eu-west-1 at 1818955000. global rollout is partial.

deploy-bot: automatica: rollout status -> 4.14.2: 12% capacity, regions: eu-west-1 (100%), us-west-2 (10%), ap-southeast-1 (0%). pinlist updated by @release-bot.

maya: ok, proposal: put a safehold (soft-pin) on further unpin/unfreeze in regions that haven't rolled yet. that buys time to triage without full rollback.

sam: +1. We need concrete rollback triggers. I'd say: (1) p99 token latency increase >200ms sustained for 10m on host groups, OR (2) error rate spike >0.2% on generation endpoints related to kvcache read errors, OR (3) regression in our canonical eval prompts (longseq) failing acceptance checks.

alex: agree. add one more: any customer P1s reporting degraded chat response times within the change window => immediate rollback.

jordan: ops-bot ran the canary diff and flagged increased memory churn on the quant path. not severe yet but correlates with kvcache misses. I'll instrument an additional trace and surface metrics to the release dashboard.

ops-bot: added metric: runtime.kv_miss_rate and runtime.kernel_memory_delta to the release dashboard. alert rules deployed: kv_miss_rate > 0.03 for 5m -> pager to eng-oncall.

lee: runbook note: rollback path is manual pin to 4.14.1 via deploy-bot pinlist command: `deploy-bot pin runtime 4.14.1 --scope region=eu-west-1` then scale down 4.14.2 instances and drain. approx 12–18 min for full region rollback.

maya: make sure docs/release-notes mention the hotfix and the kvcache risk. I can patch the release notes and the customer-facing incident template just in case.

alex: timeline: we hold the unpin globally now, finish triage and traces by 20:30 UTC, decision at 21:00 UTC. If triggers fire before that, rollback immediately. Jordan/sam you own the triage. Lee to handle pin ops. Maya to update notes. I'll be oncall for the cutover window.

sam: started a short reproducer run against eu-west pool with verbose tracing, posting logs to the thread as I get them.

jordan: instrumented kernel-level metrics and a targeted canary of the model path in a non-prod shard. early sign: kv_miss_rate spikes on sequences with repeated context updates. pushing a small workaround patch to kv read backoff to try in canary — non-urgent, won't be merged without sign-off.

deploy-bot: alert: runtime.kv_miss_rate crossed threshold in eu-west-1 at sample window 1819008750. Notifying eng-oncall.

lee: confirmed. initiating pin command to stop new 4.14.2 rolls. executing: `deploy-bot set-pin runtime 4.14.1 --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2`

alex: good — log rollback plan and timeline in the runbook channel. Also flag any impacted customers to CS with a short note template: "We're pausing a runtime upgrade due to performance regressions on long-context workloads; no data loss expected; rollback in progress." Maya please prep.

maya: prepping notes now. Will create incident placeholder in #incidents and link this thread.

sam: reproducer logs attached to the thread (s3://ci-logs/repro-1819008642.tar.gz). early root cause suspicion: quantized kernel path index race when cache miss + async refill.

jordan: if workaround confirms improvement in canary, we can either ship a targeted patch or proceed with rollback then ship a patch and re-roll. preference: rollback + patch to be safe.

alex: consensus = safehold + immediate pin in affected regions, triage w/ root cause, rollback if triggers escalate, patch & retest, then a cautious re-roll with extended canary. I'll send the cutover advisory to infra-owner list. 

lee: pinned regions updated. I'll watch for drain completion and post status.

deploy-bot: pin action complete. 4.14.1 is pinned in requested regions. Rollout of 4.14.2 halted.

maya: thanks team. will follow up with release notes + incident stub. keep this thread for status. :thumbsup:
